_comment_confidence: QuantAgent confidence must exceed this threshold for a setup to reach StrategyAgent.
_comment_sl: Default SL = entry ± (ATR_14 × 1.5). StrategyAgent may narrow but not widen.
_comment_tp: Minimum reward-to-risk ratio of 2:1 for a setup to be included in playbook.
_comment_conviction: Confidence >= 0.80 → high conviction (2% risk). >= 0.65 → standard (1% risk). < 0.65 → SKIP, do not publish.
